description: This file defines the GetBucketLocationParser class, which customizes parsing behavior for the GetBucketLocation operation in AWS S3 service interactions, particularly adjusting the interpretation of the LocationConstraint response field.

classes.name: GetBucketLocationParser
classes.description: A parser class that decorates an existing parser to handle the GetBucketLocation operation in S3, specifically adjusting the LocationConstraint value based on response content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a parser callable to decorate.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the parser, and for the GetBucketLocation command, extracts and adjusts the LocationConstraint to a standard format.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates stream parsing to the underlying parser.
